positions.subject: q:taxes/lower-top-income-tax-rates
positions.summary: Becerra endorsed Yes on Proposition 3, which makes the existing income tax rates on high incomes permanent, and at the Sept. 30 debate criticized Hilton's income tax plan as including a tax cut for the wealthiest earners.

citations.quote: YES on Prop 3: The California Children’s Education and Health Care Protection Act of 2026
He pointed out that Hilton’s plan to drop income taxes on the first $150,000 in earnings also includes a tax cut for the state’s wealthiest earners, comparing it to federal tax cuts enacted by Trump.

"Absolutely he's wrong; he would damage the state even harder for working families," Becerra said, arguing the tax cuts would primarily benefit wealthy Californians while reducing funding for schools and healthcare.
